title: Council Rock
summary: Council Rock is remembered in relation to Fort Hill Cemetery and a Montaukett meeting and burial landscape. Public mapping uses broad orientation only and does not identify graves, ceremony locations, the exact rock, or other sensitive details.
map_geometry_source: Broad public orientation point on Fort Hill Road by Fort Hill Cemetery from OSM/Nominatim and Directus text; not the cemetery, exact rock, or grave location.
ancestral_territory_note: Shown in relation to Montaukett Ancestral Land on the current ancestral territory map.
why_this_matters: Situated on a scenic bluff overlooking Fort Pond, this sacred thirty-acre cemetery and former Montaukett fortification recently saw the repatriation of ancestral remains previously taken by the Smithsonian Institution. The successful return of these ancestors highlights the ongoing, critical work of modern Indigenous nations to reclaim their cultural heritage and protect their ancestral resting places from institutional desecration.
